mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters indicates strengthening economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with positive GDP growth, or GDP growth and SPX returns show a negative correlation over a 5-year period (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based increase in economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not show a statistically significant positive correlation with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded and the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained CPI increases, or the correlation between CPI increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement in PAYEMS and UNRATE does not show a statistically significant positive correlation with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a slowdown in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
